title: Do Investors Care Who Did the Audit? Evidence from Form AP

scopes.description: Full supplied author workflow: per-date TAQ construction and append programs; PCAOB Form AP preparation; SEC filing-index acquisition; R inspection matching; the primary SAS preparation pipeline; and the Stata restatement link. The package contains code and final-sample identifiers but no prepared analysis panel, so no analysis_only bypass is supported. The primary SAS creates volumerestatements2 and provides its Stata trim/scale setup snippet; paper-wide regression/table code omitted from this release is contextual, not a prerequisite to the supplied preparation workflow.

issues.description: The primary SAS creates outside_participants2 after adding Filing_Date, but no SAS export creates the outside_participantsv2.sas7bdat filename/schema read by R. R writes AP Inspection Findings.csv, which the primary SAS later imports as PCAOB_Inspections; this interleaved handoff needs its exact aliases/fields confirmed.

The primary SAS selects dum_male from identifiers2 without explicitly defining it in the supplied code. Since Identifiers uses SELECT A.*,B.* and identifiers2 carries a.*, the imported Form AP/source fields could supply it; ownership remains unresolved until the actual source schemas and producer are confirmed.

The Stata preprocessing file has GUI-style load/save commands omitted, an empty joinby cikcode path, and a separate Restatements.dta merge input whose producer/schema are unspecified. Primary SAS Section 6 expects the resulting Stata output as Restatements. The supplied Stata trim/scale snippet at the end of primary SAS is a separate setup handoff.

The TAQ programs require a separately prepared tradingdays.tdate schedule and dated CTM/CQM/NBBO/MAST tables, while the append script seeds each product from 20150102 and uses distinct WRDS paths. The date span, source access, per-date schema/coverage and coherent output roots remain unverified; a catalog miss is not evidence of absent access.

#Step 2: The TAQ data is stored in files by trading day. In the Trading Days output folder, you will need to store a SAS file

#Step 3: Run the programs to generate the trading, price, and spread data for each company in each day (on WRDS cloud).

evidence.description: The R deficiency program reads a prepared SAS participant file and expects filing date and country information for the subsequent joins.
evidence.file: Programs for Submission/03 R Program Deficiencies/Merge Outside Part with Inspection Findings.R
evidence.quote:
###Read and clean countries list output
#Read in listing of audit participants listed in Form APs from our study. Here, the observations represent unique auditor participants in Form AP. Dataset is stored as "Countries_List"
library(haven)
Countries_List <- data.frame(read_sas("outside_participantsv2.sas7bdat"))

#Identify Form AP date (rounded down to day of filing time)
library(lubridate)
Countries_List$AP_Date <- floor_date(Countries_List$Filing_Date, "day")

#Merge in country identifiers - Country names is a linking table that matches the country names in the Form AP data to the AA data. Note that there are more countries included in the AP data than are included in the inspections data. Where the table has "NA" it indicates that the country does not exist in the inspections data.
library(dplyr)
Countries_List <- inner_join(Countries_List, Country_Names, by = "Country")

actions.description: Acquire the official PCAOB AuditorSearch Form AP CSV and perform the manual filing-time and outside-participant preparation documented by the primary SAS.
steps: Use the AuditorSearch whole-dataset CSV as the Form AP source; preserve its original headers and time-zone semantics.
Carry out the author-described filing-time text preparation and create OtherParticipantsFile from the outside-auditor participant field.
Import the prepared products into SAS as PCAOB_filing and OtherParticipantsFile; retain the supplied final-sample ID CSV only as an identifier reference.
validation: Before SAS processing, compare the prepared headers/field types with the Form AP fields consumed in the code and record the date span and row coverage.

actions.description: Confirm the WRDS TAQ date schedule and dated-table access, or a compatible staged local route, then make every TAQ library and append output root coherent with that schedule.
steps: Confirm access and compatible schemas for ct.ctm_YYYYMMDD, cq.cqm_YYYYMMDD, nbbo.nbbom_YYYYMMDD and mast.mastm_YYYYMMDD through the documented WRDS route or a compatible staged route; the local catalog lookup does not establish these dynamic tables.
